facts.fact: David 在恐怖论坛 TheUncannyValley 发出人生第一个主题帖（标题 SUBJECT: WHAT IS PUBLIC ACCESS AFTERWORLD?），称 Erin 的录像是 switch-off 三小时后于凌晨 2:56am 在 hartsdale, ny 的 channel 4 录到的，并在帖底附了 GlobalVill 上传链接。
facts.anchor: Check out this recording from the other night. Captured at 2:56am on channel 4 in hartsdale, ny, three hours after the switch-off.

facts.fact: 在高三（junior year）最后一天第一节课前，David 和 Erin 把 Erin 的录像从 VHS 转录成 DVD（用 Ms. Walsh 的 AV dungeon 里的设备），好让 David 回家后用自己的台式机上传。
facts.anchor: And so before first period on the last day of junior year, the two of them dubbed Erin’s recording from VHS to DVD on the equipment in Ms. Walsh’s AV dungeon so David could upload it later on his desktop at home.

facts.fact: Auxiliaries 社团里 Ralph 当面断定视频是假货（“Nice hoax”），双胞胎之一的 Fran 说 “You can tell it was made in iMovie”，另一位 Leslie 则表示如果 Erin 说她看到了就相信她；David 为此与 Ralph 互相挥拳，被 Ms. Walsh 喝止。
facts.anchor: “This video is a fake,” Ralph said. He shook his head at Erin. “I can’t believe you let David put you up to this. Nice hoax. Next, please.”

facts.fact: TheUncannyValley 的版主 platformagnostic 回帖称 “Cursed videos belong in the ‘board art + writing’ subforum, not on main”，随后锁帖禁止任何人再回复；David 的帖子当天只有全大写 “FAKE” 之类的敷衍回帖。
facts.anchor: “Cursed videos belong in the ‘board art + writing’ subforum, not on main,” the mod wrote, then locked David’s thread so no one else could reply.

facts.fact: David 在论坛多年只潜水、从未注册账号发帖；他判断 Google 上搜 “public access afterworld” 毫无结果，意味着除 Erin 外没人录下或注意到这次 signal intrusion——帖被锁后他自责搞砸了进入这个 outcast 社区的最好机会。
facts.anchor: And judging by the lack of search results for “public access afterworld” on Google, no one else had recorded or even noticed the signal intrusion that Erin had managed to capture.

facts.fact: David 私下其实没看懂广播，只觉得是 bargain-basement surrealism（如 Ralph 所说的 bad student film），但仍怂恿 Erin、炒热谜团，因为怕不这样就会失去她；他仍担心周五晚那记失败的 kiss 已毁掉两人的关系。
facts.anchor: He egged Erin on. He built up the mystery. He feared if he didn’t, he would lose her.

facts.fact: 暑假 David 在 CVS 打工，每周五、周日、周二、周四凌晨四点起床卸货卡车（州内最后一家 Blockbuster 已于去年秋天永久关门，他只好另找 backup plan），下午下班后常独自吃 baked ziti。
facts.anchor: So that summer, David spent his Fridays, Sundays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays waking up at four a.m. to unload the delivery truck, listening to the same store mixtape of pop-country on repeat as he stocked hemorrhoid cream and self-administered douches.

facts.fact: 暑假多数夜晚 David 和 Erin 在她家地下室盯着 static、手边备着一叠空白 VHS 带想重现第一次广播，但只看到 fuzz；六月最后一周 Erin 随父亲去波士顿参观 MIT 校园（她秋季将以 Early Decision 申请该校）；章末 David 快要放弃时，一条新线索进入他的 inbox。
facts.anchor: During the last week of June, Erin took a trip to Boston with her dad to tour the MIT campus, where she’d be applying Early Decision in the fall.
